event.description: Test block-0 pre-attention bias coordinate 1 independently
event.proposal: Family: scalar pruning. Current retained frontier is 2,120 parameters at 99.200000%, a +0.200000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 12 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0048 at 2,120 parameters and 99.20%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0050, where blocks.0.ln1 coordinate 4 scored 98.68%. The next untested original-magnitude candidate is blocks.0.ln1 coordinate 1 at -0.016125478. Hypothesis: independently fixing coordinate 1 to zero may be less damaging than coordinates 15 and 4, yielding 2,119 parameters while preserving the eight accepted zeros. This is more informative than abandoning the site before testing its final low-magnitude candidate, because coordinate-specific results have already overturned a simple magnitude rule.
